title: APEC Python fundamentals lab test
summary: After two months of either ChatGPT-based APEC instruction or conventional lectures and labs, novice students complete the same 30-minute Python lab test. They implement a function that computes list statistics, print the results, and handle errors without using ChatGPT during the test.

sources.title: Generative AI for Programming Education: Can ChatGPT Facilitate the Acquisition of Fundamental Programming Skills for Novices?
sources.evidence_quote: The lab test was 30 minutes in duration.

context.learner_level: undergraduate students with no prior programming knowledge

assessment.summary: Implement and debug a Python function that computes and returns the sum, average, minimum, and maximum of a list, then print the results and handle errors.
student_actions: Define a function that accepts a list of numbers.
Call the function and print each result.
Handle errors with try and except blocks.

student_role.description: One group learned through the APEC ChatGPT framework, but both groups completed the post-intervention lab test in the same desktop environment without reported ChatGPT access.

grading.method: The researchers compared programming performance on the submitted lab-test program between the two instructional groups.
